C1.worst_defect: The home page's 'Before you start' block mixes the counter needs with developer requirements (Node, Postgres, the RxDB Premium licence token), and the refund row says 'settles it with two Admin API calls'. A non-developer owner hits jargon on the first page they read.
C1.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04, 'Before you start' and the 'Live demo or your own store' table

C2.worst_defect: The phone cashier-sheet screenshot shows 'open since 22:07' next to 'Last synced 10:07 PM': 24-hour and 12-hour clocks in the same image. The desktop version (22:06) has no Sync row, so the two shots of one screen disagree.

C3.worst_defect: On the owner's own store, staff cannot refund at the till on plugin 0.3.0. A Dashboard refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls', so every refund needs the freelancer. At-the-till's Refund section only says to ask whoever manages Vendure, and does not say each refund stays Pending until that is done.
C3.where: home.desktop.02 refund row; at-the-till Refund section; plugin-setup 'Settle a Dashboard refund'

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting puts cashier advice ('At the counter: leave the app open and do not reload it') on the same page as raw GraphQL ('Resolve one with tallyResolveNeedsAdmin, using applied or rejected'). An owner reading between customers has to scroll past code meant for the developer.
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 / text troubleshooting 'When till updates need attention' and the needs_admin section

C5.worst_defect: In dark mode the hero till screenshot stays light, a bright block on a dark page. Otherwise the type, spacing and docs chrome are clean and consistent.

C6.worst_defect: At the till, the cashier guide an owner would read on a phone, runs to 9 phone slices (~9.8k px). The phone cashier-sheet screenshot has a grey strip down its left edge. The phone hero also shows a phone-sized till although the docs say 'tablets/phones untested'.

C7.worst_defect: Minor only: the 404 page carries no JSON-LD, and Lighthouse lists small unused-JS findings. Perf is 98/100/100/100, metadata is full, llms.txt/sitemap/robots are fine, and search for 'offline' returns the right pages.

overall_worst.defect: For a shop owner without a developer on hand, refunds are the deal-breaker. On plugin 0.3.0 a refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls'. The cashier guide's Refund section never says plainly that every refund needs the developer before it leaves Pending.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 refund row; at-the-till Refund section
overall_worst.fix: In at-the-till's Refund section, add one plain sentence: 'On your own store each refund shows Pending until whoever runs your Vendure settles it'. Link it to plugin-setup#settle-a-dashboard-refund, and give the freelancer one copy-paste block covering both calls.
